items.title: Devissage criterion I: a property of coherent sheaves on a Noetherian scheme that is stable under extensions and holds for pushforwards of quasi-coherent ideal sheaves on integral closed subschemes holds for every coherent sheaf.
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter coherent.tex (Cohomology of Schemes)

items.difficulty_reason: The whole argument is in the span. The proof first shows, from stability under extensions (property (1)) and induction along a finite filtration, that any coherent sheaf admitting a filtration whose successive subquotients have the property also has the property; this filtration step is spelled out, not just named. It then invokes the chapter's coherent-filter lemma for the existence of a filtration with subquotients of the form handled in assumption (2), i.e. pushforwards of quasi-coherent ideals on integral closed subschemes, and concludes. The existence-of-filtration input is a named citation to a proved lemma; the devissage logic binding it to the extension-stability is the author's own written induction.
